decisions.reason: A coolant pressure booster fits the firm's core coolant-management portfolio, is still at an uncertain early stage after one year, and costs little to keep as a modular option.
The centrifuge extends the filtration line and serves sustainability demand, so keeping the option open is cheap while market feedback is still limited.
Coolant nozzles are a low-cost complementary component that supports system sales, so keeping them carries little holding cost.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a core product for metalworking customers with steady demand, so there is no evidence to justify abandoning it.
The magnetic belt conveyor complements the conveyor range for fine ferrous chips and shares the same production base, so the option is cheap to maintain.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are a standard, high-volume line in the firm's portfolio, and their stable demand justifies continued commitment.
